subject: Monthly performance digest + QBR prep: Feb dashboard & action items
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-25T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Monthly performance digest + QBR prep: Feb dashboard & action items

Hi team,

Attached is the Feb dashboard snapshot and the raw uptime logs. High level callouts:

- Uptime: 99.94% for the month, but we had a 90-minute partial outage on 2027-02-14 impacting two regions (see uptime-logs-feb.csv).
- Latency: p50 steady at 40ms but p95 moved from 320ms -> 610ms week-over-week for streaming endpoints.
- Cost: overall token spend +18% MoM driven by a small spike in long-sequence generation from a single partner account (Acme Corp).
- Usage: Prod active users +22% MoM; requests/sec peaked 2/16 at 1.9x baseline.

I want the leadership digest to have a concise narrative for QBR: causes, mitigations, and OKR impact (latency and cost OKRs). Please respond with owner's name for each action below by EOD Thursday so I can assemble slides:

1) Post-incident RCA for 2/14 outage (owner: __)
2) Kernel regression investigation for p95 latency increase (owner: __)
3) Short-term routing/capacity adjustments for Acme spike (owner: __)
4) Cost mitigation plan (quantization/batching recommendations) for Q1 reforecast (owner: __)

Attachments: 2027-02-month-dashboard.pdf, uptime-logs-feb.csv, cost-breakdown-Q1.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll compile responses and draft the one-pager for Friday’s leadership review.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
VP, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-26T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Monthly performance digest + QBR prep: Feb dashboard & action items

Thanks Olga — good concise framing. Quick notes inline:

- 2/14 outage: Ops has a partial timeline; preliminary signal points to a storage throttle during a cross-region rebalance. @laura — can you confirm whether the rebalance was triggered by autoscaler churn?

- p95 jump: I suspect the new fused-attn kernel we rolled on 2/10 contributed. We saw pattern matching across models with long prefixes. I'll pull perf traces and run an A/B with the previous kernel.

- Acme spike: I pinged Sam at Acme to ask for the query patterns; looks like long-sequence batch jobs (overnight) started phasing into production. If true, we can recommend a dedicated routing policy and burst window.

Action owners (my proposals):
1) RCA 2/14 outage — Laura Bennett (ops lead)
2) Kernel regression deep-dive — Markus Klein (perf) + Research to validate
3) Routing/capacity changes for Acme — Marissa Cole (customer ops) + Account team
4) Cost mitigation — Markus + Platform tooling (quantization experiment lead TBD)

Planned deliverables: short RCA doc by Tue 3/2, perf A/B results by Mon 3/1, routing proposal by EOD 3/1.

On the QBR narrative — Olga, can you include the impact on the latency OKR and propose an adjusted confidence band?

-Markus

2) We are willing to coordinate routing rules or a reserved burst window to avoid impacting our SLAs; can you propose a temporary routing policy while you investigate?

Consolidated actions (owners & deliverables):
- RCA for 2/14 outage — Laura Bennett — deliverable: 1-page timeline + root cause (ETA 2027-03-02). Attachment: uptime-logs-feb.csv (used).
- Kernel regression investigation — Markus Klein + Research — deliverable: perf traces + A/B results + rollback recommendation (ETA 2027-03-01).
- Acme routing + burst window — Marissa Cole (Customer Ops) + Account team — deliverable: temporary routing proposal + estimated cost delta (ETA 2027-03-01). Sam (Acme), please confirm a preferred window; Marissa will draft.
- Cost mitigation plan — Markus + Platform Tools — deliverable: quantization recommendation deck + 30/60/90 impact estimate (ETA 2027-03-05).

OKR/QBR slide asks for leadership:
- One slide with incident impact (outage minutes, affected regions, customer impact) — Laura
- One slide with latency delta narrative + mitigation plan — Markus
- One slide with short-term customer routing commitments and cost impact — Marissa
- One slide with Q1 forecast revisions if recommended (finance cc’d) — Olga

Notes: We should also include a short appendix with the raw cost breakout (cost-breakdown-Q1.xlsx) and the Drive link to the dashboard (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1q2w3e4-dashboard).

Sam — appreciate the offer for traces; that would help the perf investigation. Marissa will reach out to set up a short sync with your SREs.

I’ll assemble the slides Thursday night and circulate a draft by 9am Friday so leadership has time to review before the QBR.

Thanks all — feel free to add any outstanding asks.
